source_caption:
Tulsa King (2022) is a crime drama series starring Sylvester Stallone as Dwight “The General” Manfredi, a New York Mafia capo who is released from prison after serving 25 years. Instead of receiving the welcome he expects, Dwight is sent by his mob family to Tulsa, Oklahoma, where he is expected to establish a new criminal operation.

Arriving in a completely unfamiliar environment, Dwight quickly realizes that he has been left without the influence and connections he once had in New York. Rather than accepting his diminished position, he begins building a new crew from people he encounters in Tulsa. As his criminal empire grows, Dwight must deal with competitors, law enforcement, shifting loyalties, and the realization that the Mafia family he once trusted may not have his best interests at heart.

The series explores themes of loyalty, ambition, power, identity, and the consequences of living within a criminal world. Dwight is confident, experienced, and willing to use intimidation, but his long absence from society also forces him to confront how much the world has changed. His relationships with the people around him reveal a more complicated side of a character who is trying to regain control of his life while continuing to make morally questionable choices.

What makes Dwight’s story especially interesting is the contrast between his old-school Mafia mentality and the modern world he has returned to. Tulsa becomes more than a new territory for his criminal ambitions—it becomes a place where he has to redefine his position, build new relationships, and decide how much of his old identity he is willing to carry forward.

More than just a crime series, Tulsa King is about a man trying to rebuild his power and sense of purpose after losing 25 years of his life, while discovering that loyalty, family, and success can come with a heavy price.

💬 Can someone truly start over after spending decades living a life built on crime, or does the past always catch up with them?

source_details.synopsis: Tulsa King is an American comedy and crime drama television series created by Taylor Sheridan for the streaming platform Paramount+. The series stars Sylvester Stallone as Dwight "The General" Manfredi, an American Mafia caporegime who has been recently released from prison in New York and is sent to Tulsa, Oklahoma, where he begins to set up a criminal organization. It is Stallone's first leading role in a scripted television series. The series also stars Andrea Savage, Martin Starr, Jay Will, Max Casella, Domenick Lombardozzi, Vincent Piazza, A. C.
